A Ball for Pokémon hooked by a Rod.

Lure Ball has a 4x catch rate multiplier on Pokémon encountered through fishing. Whether you're using an Old Rod, Good Rod, or Super Rod, this ball dramatically improves your odds.

Made from Blue Apricorns by Kurt. Essential for fishing enthusiasts chasing rare Water-types. Stock up before heading to any fishing spots - it makes catching things like Qwilfish or Corsola much less tedious!
